program.name: The Athletic Pivot
program.subtitle: The Athletic Pivot — Train Smart, Recover Faster

items.name: World's Greatest Stretch
items.detail: 5 reps/side — Opens hips, thoracic spine, and chest.

items.name: Arm Walkouts to Plank
items.detail: 5 reps — Wakes up core and shoulder stability.

items.name: Elastic Pogo Hops
items.detail: 30 seconds — Springy ankle bounces to fire up your CNS.

recovery.title: Creatine
recovery.desc: 5g daily. Clears brain fog under sleep deprivation.

recovery.title: Protein Anchor
recovery.desc: 20–30g fast protein before touching any sugar craving.

recovery.title: Adrenal Salt
recovery.desc: Warm water + sea salt pinch when dragging. Kills cravings.

tips: You are not a dieter. You are an athlete in a high-stress preparation phase. The gym's only job right now is to be a stress reliever, not a stress producer.
A 15-minute session where you stretch your shoulders, pull a cable bar a few times, and breathe deeply is an unbelievable athletic victory.
Sleep is the training session. When work intensity spikes, your brain uses sleep as a survival mechanism. Honor it.
Lifting heavy but leaving 1–2 reps in reserve builds dry, dense muscle tissue. That tissue burns fat 24/7.
High cortisol can bloat the scale by 5–8 lbs overnight with water retention. That's not fat — it's stress. Flush it with Zone 2 and deep sleep.
Take your creatine, prioritize your sleep, play with your kid during Day 4, and watch your body respond to recovery.
Focus on adding 5 lbs to your leg press or shaving 10 seconds off your Day 4 circuit. Your physique changes as a side effect.
The 15-Minute Protein Anchor: when a sugar craving hits, eat 20–30g of protein first and wait 15 minutes. The craving will shrink dramatically.

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.note: Control the negative, explode up. Leave 2 RIR. This is your anchor lift.

exercises.name: Single-Arm DB Row
exercises.note: Drive elbow to hip, squeeze lat at top.

exercises.name: Incline DB Press (30°)
exercises.note: Rest 60s after 2b. Focus on chest stretch at the bottom.

exercises.name: DB Hammer Curls
exercises.note: Neutral grip targets brachialis for arm thickness.

exercises.name: Parallel Bar Dips
exercises.note: Rest 60s after 3b. Keep shoulders safe — don't dip too deep.

exercises.name: Day 1 Abs Circuit (×3)
exercises.note: Keep lower back FLAT on mat the entire time. Rest 45s between rounds.

exercises.name: Zone 2 Aerobic Flush
exercises.note: Sweat heavily but you can still talk. This flushes stress cortisol water from your body.

exercises.name: Leg Press (Heavy Tempo)
exercises.note: 3 seconds down, 1 second pause, explosive drive up. Quad destroyer.

exercises.name: Dumbbell RDLs
exercises.note: Hinge hard at hips. Feel a massive stretch through your glutes and hamstrings.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raises
exercises.note: Rest 60s after 2b. Flex hard at the top, slow on the way down.

exercises.name: DB Box Step-Ups
exercises.note: Drive through the heel of the working leg. Full hip extension at the top.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curls
exercises.note: Rest 60s after 3b. Focus on the squeeze at full contraction.

exercises.name: Day 2 Abs Circuit (×3)
exercises.note: No equipment needed. Rest 45s between rounds. Focus entirely on anti-rotation stability.

exercises.name: Zone 2 Aerobic Flush
exercises.note: On the treadmill or bike post-lift. Flushes metabolic waste out of your legs.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.note: Squeeze lats downward. Keep chest proud and spine long. 2 RIR.

exercises.name: DB Incline Fly (30°)
exercises.note: Wide arc, feel the deep chest stretch. Not a press — fly.

exercises.name: Face Pulls / DB Reverse Fly
exercises.note: Rest 60s after 2b. Pull rear delts. Critical for posture under desk stress.

exercises.name: Preacher Curls
exercises.note: Isolate the bicep peak. Controlled stretch at the bottom.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.note: Rest 60s after 3b. Deep stretch into the long head for horseshoe shape.

exercises.name: Day 3 Abs Circuit (×3)
exercises.note: Lying on mat. Rest 45s between rounds. Lower belly compression work.

exercises.name: Zone 2 Aerobic Flush
exercises.note: Fires up slow-twitch fibers and lowers nervous system tension before you leave.

days.name: Home Crucible
days.intro: Zero machines. Zero dumbbells. Do this in the living room, backyard, or park with your kid! Complete exercises 1–5 back-to-back. Rest 90s. Repeat for 4 rounds. Let your kid mimic the moves — especially the Bear Crawls. 🐻

exercises.name: Air Squats
exercises.note: Heels flat. Add a hop at the top for explosive variation. Perfect to race your kid.

exercises.name: Lateral Skater Hops
exercises.note: Leap sideways, land softly on one foot, spring back. Huge glute and stability work.

exercises.name: Push-Ups
exercises.note: Drop to knees if form breaks, or do elevated with hands on a couch. Quality beats quantity.

exercises.name: Bear Crawls
exercises.note: Knees 1 inch off the floor, back dead flat. The hardest core exercise hiding in plain sight.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunches (Mat)
exercises.note: Slow and controlled. Opposite elbow to knee. This finishes the family circuit.
